entities.name: Abu Abd Allah al-Burtuqali Muhammad ibn Muhammad
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Muhammad al-Burtuqali, succeeded his father Abu Abd Allah al-Sheikh Muhammad ibn Yahya to become the second Wattasid Sultan in 1504. He died in 1526 and was succeeded by his son Abu al-Abbas Ahmad ibn Muhammad.
